statements.select:
SELECT A.OPPT_CD , A.OPPT_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_TYPE', A.OPPT_TYPE) AS OPPT_TYPE_NM , A.ITEM_CD , DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NM(A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_NM , (SELECT ITEM_CD2 FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_CD2 , A.BIZ_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'BIZ_TYPE', A.BIZ_TYPE) AS BIZ_TYPE_NM , (SELECT dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ITEM_TYPE', ITEM_TYPE) FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_TYPE_NM , A.CUST_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.CUST_CD) AS CUST_NM , (SELECT BAD_AR_YN FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_CD = A.CUST_CD) AS BAD_AR_YN , A.USER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , A.DEPT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(A.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM , A.EUSER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.EUSER_CD) AS EUSER_NM , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) = 0 THEN A.DSTR_TYPE ELSE B.DSTR_TYPE END AS DSTR_TYPE , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) = 0 THEN dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', A.DSTR_TYPE) ELSE dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', B.DSTR_TYPE) END AS DSTR_TYPE_NM , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) = 0 THEN A.OPPT_STATUS ELSE B.OPPT_STATUS END AS OPPT_STATUS , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) = 0 THEN dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_STATUS', A.OPPT_STATUS) ELSE dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_STATUS', B.OPPT_STATUS) END AS OPPT_STATUS_NM , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) = 0 THEN A.WSO_PSBLT ELSE B.WSO_PSBLT END AS WSO_PSBLT , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) = 0 THEN dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'WSO_PSBLT', A.WSO_PSBLT) ELSE dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'WSO_PSBLT', B.WSO_PSBLT) END AS WSO_PSBLT_NM , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) = 0 THEN (SELECT VALUE_2 FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'WSO_PSBLT' AND CODE_ID = A.WSO_PSBLT) ELSE (SELECT VALUE_2 FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'WSO_PSBLT' AND CODE_ID = B.WSO_PSBLT) END AS WSO_PSBLT_VALUE , A.BASE_CRNY , A.EXCH_RATE , (SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS OPPT_QTY , CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) != 0 THEN (SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD)/(SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) ELSE 0 END AS OPPT_UNIT_PRC , (SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS AMOUNT , (SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS KRW_AMOUNT , A.PJT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_PJT_NM(A.PJT_CD) AS PJT_NM , A.WSO_PDATE , A.OPPT_SUMRY , A.RFC_CD , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(OPPT_CD) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CNFM_YN , #base_y#+#base_m# AS BASE_YM FROM T_OPPORTUNITY A LEFT JOIN T_OPPT_FCST B ON A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.OPPT_CD = B.OPPT_CD AND B.BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m# LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.OPPT_STATUS IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'OPPT_STATUS' AND VALUE_1 = 'Y') AND A.DROP_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN ='Y'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_nm#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
AND A.WSO_PDATE BETWEEN REPLACE(#sdate#, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#edate#, '-', '')
AND (A.CUST_CD LIKE '%'+ #cust_cd# +'%' OR DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.CUST_CD) LIKE '%'+ #cust_nm# +'%')
AND A.BIZ_TYPE = #biz_type#
AND A.OPPT_TYPE = #oppt_type#
AND A.OPPT_STATUS = #oppt_status#
AND A.EUSER_CD = #euser_cd#
AND A.ITEM_CD IN (SELECT ITEM_CD FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_TYPE = #item_type#)
AND A.ITEM_CD IN (SELECT ITEM_CD FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_NM = #item_nm#)
AND A.RFC_CD = #rfc_cd#
AND A.WSO_PSBLT = #wso_psblt#
AND A.WSO_PSBLT in ('WSOPB_100', 'WSOPB_200')
AND A.CUST_CD IN (SELECT CUST_CD FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE BCUST_CD LIKE '%'+ #bcust_cd# +'%' OR DBO.FN_GET_BCUST_NM(BCUST_CD) LIKE '%'+ #bcust_nm+'%'+ #)
AND A.PJT_CD = #pjt_cd#
AND (SELECT COUNT(OPPT_CD) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) > 0
AND (SELECT COUNT(OPPT_CD) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BASE_YM = #base_y#+#base_m#) <= 0

SELECT A.OPPT_CD , A.OPPT_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_TYPE', A.OPPT_TYPE) AS OPPT_TYPE_NM , A.ITEM_CD , DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NM(A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_NM , (SELECT ITEM_CD2 FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_CD2 , A.BIZ_TYPE , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'BIZ_TYPE', A.BIZ_TYPE) AS BIZ_TYPE_NM , (SELECT dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'ITEM_TYPE', ITEM_TYPE) FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CD = A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_TYPE_NM , A.CUST_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.CUST_CD) AS CUST_NM , (SELECT BAD_AR_YN FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_CD = A.CUST_CD) AS BAD_AR_YN , A.USER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , A.DEPT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(A.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM , A.EUSER_CD , DBO.FN_GET_CUST_NM(A.EUSER_CD) AS EUSER_NM , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) = 0 THEN A.DSTR_TYPE ELSE B.DSTR_TYPE END AS DSTR_TYPE , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) = 0 THEN dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', A.DSTR_TYPE) ELSE dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE', B.DSTR_TYPE) END AS DSTR_TYPE_NM , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) = 0 THEN A.OPPT_STATUS ELSE B.OPPT_STATUS END AS OPPT_STATUS , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) = 0 THEN dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_STATUS', A.OPPT_STATUS) ELSE dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'OPPT_STATUS', B.OPPT_STATUS) END AS OPPT_STATUS_NM , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) = 0 THEN A.WSO_PSBLT ELSE B.WSO_PSBLT END AS WSO_PSBLT , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) = 0 THEN dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'WSO_PSBLT', A.WSO_PSBLT) ELSE dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'WSO_PSBLT', B.WSO_PSBLT) END AS WSO_PSBLT_NM , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = A.COMPANY_CD AND OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) = 0 THEN (SELECT VALUE_2 FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'WSO_PSBLT' AND CODE_ID = A.WSO_PSBLT) ELSE (SELECT VALUE_2 FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'WSO_PSBLT' AND CODE_ID = B.WSO_PSBLT) END AS WSO_PSBLT_VALUE , A.BASE_CRNY , A.EXCH_RATE , (SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS OPPT_QTY , CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) != 0 THEN (SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD)/(SELECT SUM(OPPT_QTY) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) ELSE 0 END AS OPPT_UNIT_PRC , (SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS AMOUNT , (SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD) AS KRW_AMOUNT , A.PJT_CD , DBO.FN_GET_PJT_NM(A.PJT_CD) AS PJT_NM , A.WSO_PDATE , A.OPPT_SUMRY , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(OPPT_CD) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CNFM_YN , ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(CLOSE_YN,'N') AS CLOSE_YN FROM T_OPPT_FCST_CLOSE WHERE BASE_YM = #base_ym#),'N') AS CHKBASEYN , A.RFC_CD , A.RFC_CHASU , #base_ym# AS BASE_YM FROM T_OPPORTUNITY A LEFT JOIN T_OPPT_FCST B ON A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.OPPT_CD = B.OPPT_CD AND B.BASE_YM = #base_ym# LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.OPPT_STATUS IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'OPPT_STATUS' AND VALUE_1 = 'Y') AND A.DROP_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN ='Y'
AND A.OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#
AND A.WSO_PDATE BETWEEN REPLACE(#sdate#, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#edate#, '-', '')
AND (SELECT COUNT(OPPT_CD) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) > 0
AND (SELECT COUNT(OPPT_CD) FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE OPPT_CD = A.OPPT_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#) <= 0
statements.delete: DELETE T_OPPT_FCST_ITEM WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd# AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#
statements.insert: INSERT INTO T_OPPT_FCST_ITEM SELECT COMPANY_CD , OPPT_CD , #base_ym# , ITEM_CD , SALES_DATE , OPPT_QTY , OPPT_UNIT_PRC , AMOUNT , KRW_AMOUNT , getdate() , #reg_usr# , getdate() , '' FROM T_OPPT_ITEM WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#

IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM T_OPPT_FCST WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd# AND BASE_YM = #base_ym# ) INSERT INTO T_OPPT_FCST SELECT COMPANY_CD , OPPT_CD , #base_ym# , ITEM_CD , PJT_CD , OPPT_TYPE , BIZ_TYPE , DSTR_TYPE , CUST_CD , EUSER_CD , USER_CD , DEPT_CD
, OPPT_STATUS , WSO_PSBLT , WSO_PDATE
, #oppt_status# , #wso_psblt# , dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#wso_pdate#, 'YYYYMMDD')
, OPPT_SUMRY , BASE_CRNY , EXCH_RATE , RFC_CD , 0 , USE_YN , GETDATE() , #reg_usr# , GETDATE() , '' FROM T_OPPORTUNITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd# ELSE UPDATE T_OPPT_FCST SET
OPPT_STATUS = (SELECT OPPT_STATUS FROM T_OPPORTUNITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#) , WSO_PSBLT = (SELECT WSO_PSBLT FROM T_OPPORTUNITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#) , WSO_PDATE = (SELECT WSO_PDATE FROM T_OPPORTUNITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd#)
OPPT_STATUS = #oppt_status# , WSO_PSBLT = #wso_psblt# , WSO_PDATE = dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#wso_pdate#, 'YYYYMMDD')
, MOD_DT = GETDATE() , MOD_USR = #mod_usr# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND OPPT_CD = #oppt_cd# AND BASE_YM = #base_ym#
